values.zh-CN: 重参数化不变性的证明

values.en: The chain rule gives $dY_r=dX_qD\phi_r$, hence the same tangent plane. The first form is the ambient inner product. For the second, the normal component of $\partial_i\partial_jY$ equals $\sum_{k,l}\langle\partial_k\partial_lX,\boldsymbol N\rangle\partial_i\phi^k\partial_j\phi^l$: the extra terms $\sum_kX_k\partial_i\partial_j\phi^k$ are tangent and pair to zero with $\boldsymbol N$. This gives the matrix congruence and equality on ambient tangent vectors. Finally $Y_1\times Y_2=(\det D\phi)(X_1\times X_2)$; normalization gives the sign formula.
values.zh-CN: 链式法则给出 $dY_r=dX_qD\phi_r$，因此切平面相同。第一形式是环境内积。对第二形式，$\partial_i\partial_jY$ 的法分量为 $\sum_{k,l}\langle\partial_k\partial_lX,\boldsymbol N\rangle\partial_i\phi^k\partial_j\phi^l$：多出的项 $\sum_kX_k\partial_i\partial_j\phi^k$ 是切向量，与法向内积为零。这给出矩阵合同变换及环境切向量上的形式相等。最后 $Y_1\times Y_2=(\det D\phi)(X_1\times X_2)$，归一化即得符号公式。
